title: Wish this was a little more powerful
text: Wish this was a little more powerful. Not very powerful and the wand is so slender that all the stuff you vacuum up gets stuck in it really easily. You'll find yourself clearing the nozzle every few minutes. The floppy extension is useless. Too floppy to position into space you need it to vacuum. Love the size and easy to turn off and on. Also, charging is fast.
